contract.endpoint: Predeclared final step only; no best-checkpoint selection
contract.tasks: Separate task estimates; no pooled Yes/No and animal performance claim
contract.seeds: Each run stays separate; prompts are not independent training seeds
contract.prompt_ci: Pointwise percentile bootstrap of whole prompt pairs, conditional on the observed family mixture and run; assumes prompt-level sampling independence
contract.family_ci: Resample whole family means with equal family weight. Sensitivity to family variation; few observed families and nonrandom construction limit inference.
contract.bounded_accuracy: Prompt-both-correct Clopper-Pearson interval is supplied only under explicit iid Bernoulli assumptions; empirical 100% bootstrap is not certainty
contract.calibration: Full-vocabulary log loss and correct-token probability accompany accuracy; no post-hoc fit or held-out threshold tuning
contract.multiplicity: Descriptive pointwise intervals, not simultaneous claims or a corrected hypothesis-testing family. No sign/permutation p-values without exchangeability assumptions.
